project_type: .NET 8 WPF worship app. Solution WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln: WorshipPlayer.Core (net8.0 class lib, data/services), WorshipPlayer.Presenter (net8.0-windows), WorshipPlayer.UI (net8.0-windows WPF), WorshipPlayer.Audio, WorshipPlayer.Tests (net8.0, xUnit).
build_system: dotnet SDK / MSBuild. WorshipPlayer.Core and WorshipPlayer.Tests are net8.0 (cross-platform, run anywhere). UI/Presenter are net8.0-windows (WPF). The Tests project cannot ProjectReference Presenter (net8.0-windows), so it <Compile Include> links specific Presenter service .cs files directly (see WorshipPlayer.Tests.csproj).
test_framework: xUnit 2.6.6 (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0, xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.5.6). Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 8.0.0 referenced by both Core and Tests.
verification_instructions: 1) Build the solution (expect 0 errors, exactly 4 pre-existing warnings: MediaLibraryPanel._currentView CS0414 x2, ChordChartWindow CS8604, WaveformEditorWindow._inReviewMode CS0414). 2) Run the targeted song tests with --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Song|FullyQualifiedName~ChordPro" (baseline 69 passed) during iteration. 3) Run the FULL test suite before finalizing (baseline 607 pass on main). Any new failure vs baseline is a regression and must be fixed, not accepted.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. app.db / song.json / setlist files are runtime data created under the build output or user-chosen folders; none are committed. Tests create their own temp folders + temp app.db under Path.GetTempPath().
environment_constraints: Windows. SQLite holds file locks: EVERY test class that opens an app.db MUST call Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() in its Dispose/teardown before deleting the temp folder, or cleanup fails intermittently (pattern already in SongLibraryServiceTests.Dispose and BibleDatabaseServiceTests). All file I/O uses absolute paths; step agents' cwd is the main repo, so use absolute worktree paths and git -C <worktree>.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo. Conventions are inferred from the already-merged Phase 0-5 code: reuse AppDatabase (no second helper, no EF), bible.db stays separate, store DDL is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run on init, one new SqliteConnection per operation (CreateConnection), string enums + WhenWritingNull for JSON round-trip. Commit locally on branch feature/sql-phase06-songs; never push.
key_patterns: Phase-5 MIRROR pattern in ServiceOrderManager.cs is the exact precedent to follow: (a) optional 'string? databasePath = null' ctor arg defaulting to AppDatabase.DefaultPath; (b) a private _initialized guard + EnsureInitializedAsync that runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS then a one-time import; (c) UpsertRowSafeAsync / ReconcileSafeAsync wrappers that try/catch-and-swallow so a DB failure NEVER changes the authoritative file behavior or events; (d) DataJson column holding the full object graph serialized with the manager's _jsonOptions, plus promoted columns for listing/search; (e) PRIMARY KEY = normalized path; (f) one-time import guarded by empty-table check, INSERT OR IGNORE, tolerate missing/malformed files, never throw, leave JSON on disk. SongUsageService.cs shows the EnsureInitializedAsync + ImportLegacyJsonIfNeededAsync shape and FormatDate/ParseDate helpers.
